our_title: dmapSave applies a non-zero offset to the null label pointer of non-root processes
ran: 'mpirun --oversubscribe -np 3 buildp/bin/dgpart 2 lbl.grf map.out' (base 1, labels): 'dmapping_io.c:170:13: runtime error: applying non-zero offset 18446744073709551612 to null pointer' on both non-root ranks (UBSan); output correct. Patched: no report, same output.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/dmapping_io.c:149 (vlbltax = NULL on non-root) and :170 (vlbltax -= grafptr->baseval; introduced by 4290e22)
evidence: dmapping_io.c:169-170: 'if (grafptr->vlblloctax != NULL) { vlbltax -= grafptr->baseval;' with vlbltax NULL on every non-root process (:149).

fix_options.label: A: base only when non-NULL
fix_options.summary: if (vlbltax != NULL) vlbltax -= grafptr->baseval; (same guard as the DMO-02 fix).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Same shape as the ordering writers after DMO-02.

fix_options.label: B: base in the root branch right after the allocation
fix_options.summary: else branch after the header write.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Moves the basing away from the gather it serves.

our_title: Sequential leaf of distributed mapping produces fragments without part array for strategies that compute none
ran: './dtest_buildp 4elt.grf -1 map "r{sep=q{strat=f}}" 4 n -' (SCOTCH_dgraphMap, np=3): 'dmapping.c:224:47: runtime error: load of null pointer of type Anum' + SEGV in dmapTerm; dgpart -m with the same strategy crashes in dmapSave (:256). Patched: Map rc=0 on all ranks; dgpart writes a 15607-line mapping with parts 0,1,2.
evidence: kdgraph_map_rb_part.c:133: 'fragptr->parttab = kgrfdat.m.parttax + kgrfdat.s.baseval;' after 'kgraphMapSt (&kgrfdat, dataptr->paraptr->stratseq)' whose default (kdgraph_map_st.c:78 '{ &stratdummy, &stratdummy, 0.05 }') computes nothing; kgraphInit only declares the part array (mapInit2 sets parttax = NULL).

fix_options.label: A: mapAlloc + kgraphFrst after kgraphInit
fix_options.summary: Initial single-domain mapping before the sequential strategy, as graphMapCompute2 (8e06be2) and kgraphMapMlUncoarsen do.
fix_options.tested: run above; dgpart/dgmap check targets, ptcheck 32/64
fix_options.tradeoffs: One Anum array per leaf (freed with the fragment); file owned by G24 (its DMO-16 hunks are at :373-398, no overlap).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Twin of PyScotch's 8e06be2 for the sequential API, and of the maintainer's kgraphMapMlUncoarsen idiom.

fix_options.label: B: lazy allocation after kgraphMapSt when parttax is NULL
fix_options.summary: Same two calls guarded by 'if (kgrfdat.m.parttax == NULL)'.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Only helps strategies that compute nothing at all; a refinement-only strategy (f, d) would still start from a NULL array, as PS2-G12-2 showed sequentially.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He fixed the sequential case by pre-allocating.

our_title: vdgraphCheck prints the sequential routine name in two messages and leaks its part array on one error path
read_only: vdgraph_check.c:234 and :262 'errorPrint ("vgraphCheck: ...")' (fixed in patch 0003); :181-188: 'if ((reduglbtab[1] != - reduglbtab[0]) || ...) { errorPrint ("vdgraphCheck: inconsistent global graph data"); return (1); }' without memFree (partgsttax) allocated at :153 (debug-only path, not patched).
why_not_run: debug-only inconsistency path, cannot be triggered without corrupting a graph

fix_options.label: A: fix the messages (done in 0003); free partgsttax before the inconsistent-data return

our_title: kdgraphMapRbPartSequ does not check the shrinking memRealloc of the fragment domain array
read_only: kdgraph_map_rb_part.c:138-139: 'if (kgrfdat.m.domnmax > kgrfdat.m.domnnbr) fragptr->domntab = memRealloc (fragptr->domntab, kgrfdat.m.domnnbr * sizeof (ArchDom));' : on failure domntab becomes NULL and the old array leaks; the fragment is then used by dmapTerm/dmapSave.
why_not_run: a failing shrinking realloc is not injectable meaningfully (glibc never fails to shrink); G19 fixed the same pattern in dgraphGhst2 (0127/0128)

fix_options.label: A: keep the old array when shrinking fails (G19's dgraphGhst2 idiom)

our_title: Non-deterministic hang of a folded sub-communicator after a collective band-separation failure
ran: LD_PRELOAD injector, FI_FUNC=vdgraphSeparateDf FI_RANK=1 FI_NTH=0 (first allocation of dgraphGhst2 under the Df call fails; dgraphGhst agrees on it, vdgraphSeparateDf then vdgraphSeparateBd fail on all processes of the sub-communicator), np=3, st_df.txt: 1 run in 3 hangs (exit 124 after 15 s) on base-combined AND on the series, the other runs finish with rc=0 on all ranks; same at nth=1 and nth=2 (nth=2 is a tolerated realloc shrink failure in dgraphGhst2 with no error message at all). Without injection the same strategy completed 6/6 runs. Per-rank traces (repro/common/trace.*, instrumented scratch tree) once showed both processes of the folded half inside vdgraphSeparateSq's vdgraphGatherAll while the other half had finished; a backtrace once showed both in dgraphHaloSync's Alltoallv of a later dgraphBand.
read_only: Not isolated: no gdb on this box; the hang is timing dependent (the injector's extra latency and the sub-communicator fold are both needed); the dgraphCoarsen fold-dup threads (dgraph_coarsen.c, dgraph_fold*.c: G18/G21) and the asynchronous halo collectives (SCOTCH_MPI_ASYNC_COLL, dgraph_halo.c: G20) are the suspects, not the vdgraph code which is the same on both sides of the collective failure.
location_7_0_17: unknown; observed below vdgraph_separate_ml.c:773-777 (vdgraphSeparateMl2 on a folded coarse graph) in dgraph_halo.c / dgraph_gather_all.c collectives
evidence: repro/common/redo.txt and scan_df_*.txt lines 'nth=0 exit=124 :: HANG; ... rank 2: OrderCompute rc=0' versus 'nth=0 exit=0' in other runs of the identical command

fix_options.label: none
fix_options.summary: needs isolation by the dgraph fold/halo owners with a debugger or MPI tracing

our_title: Diffusion methods return alone when a halo synchronization fails, hanging the other processes
ran: Same scans, nth=4..7 and 12..15: '(1): ERROR: dgraphHaloSync2: out of memory; (1): ERROR: vdgraphSeparateDf: cannot propagate diffusion data (1|2) / cannot propagate part data; (1): ERROR: vdgraphSeparateBd: cannot separate band graph' then HANG, pristine and patched alike (only rank 1 errors).
evidence: vdgraph_separate_df.c:187-191: 'if (dgraphHaloSync (...) != 0) { errorPrint ("vdgraphSeparateDf: cannot propagate diffusion data (1)"); memFree (...); return (1); }' with dgraphHaloSync2's allocation failure being local (dgraph_halo.c).

fix_options.label: none here
fix_options.summary: This is G20's halo design decision (alt A: unconditional Allreduce in dgraphHaloSync2; alt B: pre-allocated scratch at dgraphGhst time); the callers cannot fix it without an extra collective per pass.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Decided at the dgraphHaloSync level, not per caller.
